@Mojo(name="attached-rpm", defaultPhase=PACKAGE, requiresDependencyResolution=RUNTIME, threadSafe=true) public class AttachedRPMMojo extends AbstractRPMMojo
Construct the RPM file and attaches it as a secondary artifact.
